name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
usage:
"use client";

import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbEllipsis,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb";

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Home</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbEllipsis />
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Components</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Breadcrumb</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}
blurb: Semantic navigation breadcrumb trail with customizable separators.
description: Composable breadcrumb system (Breadcrumb, List, Item, Link, Page, Separator, Ellipsis) built on semantic HTML. Accessibility-first with proper ARIA roles, labels, and aria-current attributes.
use_when: Navigation trails showing page hierarchy on large sites or deep page structures.
avoid_when: Pages without clear hierarchy — adds semantic markup and DOM depth without benefit.
a11y: Full semantic breadcrumb with nav, ol/li, a elements, ARIA roles, and aria-current page indicator. Fully keyboard accessible.
